Pi`el 1. Perfect 3 masculine singular gL'Pi`el Job 38:25 cleave a channel for rain. 2. Imperative masculine singular פַּלַּג ( Ges «GKC:52n»§ 52n ) Ps 55:10 divide their speech (their counsels).
